entities.summary: Mike Sangster was a British No. 1 tennis player of the 1960s. He reached at least the quarter-final stage of each of the four Grand Slams, getting to the semi-finals of the 1963 French Open, 1961 Wimbledon and the 1961 US Open. Sangster was ranked world amateur No. 7 in 1961 by Ned Potter.
